keyCharacteristics: Bibliographic titles and direct scholarly links
Native interactions and printable public CVs
narrative.overview: A composed academic profile built around readable research evidence. Paper and mist surfaces, deep blue actions and a compact identity rail give readers a clear route from identity to manuscripts, software and contact. English and Persian share the same hierarchy and visual quality, with script-specific metrics and direction.
donts: Do not reintroduce the rejected decorative 3D presentation.
Do not publish private CV details.
dos: Do preserve keyboard focus, native disclosures and print readability.
Do separate evidence through type, rules and spacing.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Reserve emphasis for identity, research titles and actionable links; status remains readable text.

rules.name: The Script Rule
rules.body: Preserve natural spacing and direction for each script and source-language bibliographic titles.
